text: Oracle’s revenue miss and equity drop expose how surging AI demand creates near-term financial strain, magnifying costs and debt from rapid infrastructure buildouts. Moving to chip neutrality and shedding Ampere contain a misaligned hardware strategy, while a huge multi-year backlog constrains flexibility and delays stabilization.

meta.note: Convergence of record demand and financial strain signals late-cycle inversion: scale commits Oracle to a narrow corridor of future action.
